commands.name: browse-library

preferences.name: contactEmail
preferences.title: Contact Email
preferences.description: Optional. Sent to APIs that offer a polite pool for identified clients.

preferences.name: googleBooksApiKey
preferences.title: Google Books API Key
preferences.description: Required only when Google Books is enabled in Config.

preferences.name: semanticScholarApiKey
preferences.title: Semantic Scholar API Key
preferences.description: Required only when Semantic Scholar is enabled in Config.

preferences.name: coreApiKey
preferences.title: CORE API Key
preferences.description: Optional. Registered users receive better API limits

preferences.name: openUrlResolver
preferences.title: Institutional OpenURL Resolver
preferences.description: Optional library link-resolver base URL used to check institutional access

preferences.name: openAIApiKey
preferences.title: OpenAI API Key
preferences.description: Optional. Used only when OpenAI API is selected and external analysis is authorized.

preferences.name: openAIModel
preferences.title: OpenAI Model
preferences.description: Optional model identifier used by the OpenAI API provider.

preferences.name: anthropicApiKey
preferences.title: Anthropic API Key
preferences.description: Optional. Used only when Anthropic is selected and external analysis is authorized.

preferences.name: anthropicModel
preferences.title: Anthropic Model
preferences.description: Optional model identifier used by the Anthropic API provider.

preferences.name: geminiApiKey
preferences.title: Gemini API Key
preferences.description: Optional. Used only when Gemini is selected and external analysis is authorized.

preferences.name: geminiModel
preferences.title: Gemini Model
preferences.description: Optional model identifier used by the Gemini API provider.

preferences.name: enableBookSources
preferences.title: Book Sources
preferences.label: Enable basic book sources
preferences.description: Open Library, Internet Archive and Project Gutenberg. Fine-tune providers in Config.

preferences.name: enableArticleSources
preferences.title: Article Sources
preferences.label: Enable basic article sources
preferences.description: Major scholarly APIs and open repositories. Fine-tune providers in Config.

preferences.name: enableMetadataSources
preferences.title: Metadata Sources
preferences.label: Enable basic metadata sources
preferences.description: Trusted bibliographic enrichment providers. Fine-tune providers in Config.

preferences.name: enableEncyclopedias
preferences.title: Encyclopedias
preferences.label: Enable basic encyclopedias
preferences.description: SEP, IEP, Encyclopedia of Mathematics and NCBI Bookshelf.

preferences.name: includeUnknownLanguage
preferences.title: Unknown Languages
preferences.label: Include records with unknown language
preferences.description: Language details are configured inside Config.

preferences.name: showWorksWithoutAcceptedFiles
preferences.title: Metadata-only Works
preferences.label: Keep metadata-only works
preferences.description: Keep catalog records even when no accepted full-text file is found.

preferences.name: hideLowConfidenceResults
preferences.title: Result Quality
preferences.label: Hide weak matches
preferences.description: Remove weak and merely related results from simple search.

preferences.name: showUnavailableSources
preferences.title: Unavailable Sources
preferences.label: Show unavailable sources
preferences.description: Display provider errors below search results. Disabled by default so only found sources are shown.

preferences.name: defaultCitationStyle
preferences.title: Default Citation Style
preferences.description: Style used first by Bib and citation actions.

preferences.name: enableExperimentalAnalysis
preferences.title: Experimental Analysis
preferences.label: Enable experimental summaries, key points and semantic relationships
preferences.description: Disabled by default. Basic indexing, OCR, metadata matching and safe rename checks remain available.

preferences.name: analysisEngine
preferences.title: Experimental Analysis Engine
preferences.description: Used only when Experimental Analysis is enabled. Detailed options are available in Config.

preferences.name: allowExternalAnalysis
preferences.title: Experimental External AI
preferences.label: Allow extracted document text to be sent to the selected external provider
preferences.description: Used only by the experimental feature. Required for Raycast AI, OpenAI, Anthropic or Gemini. Ollama and Local Basic remain on-device.

preferences.name: renameMode
preferences.title: File Renaming
preferences.description: Automatic mode still requires exact identifier, metadata, OCR title and OCR author agreement.
